```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

this function rounds a number into the nearest whole number
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```
this function rounds a number to the first two digits
```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```
this function repeats a number (x) a specific number of times (times)
```{r}
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
here we have a character variable
```{r}
fruit <- "apple"
print(fruit)
print(class(fruit))
#next we have a numerical variable
number <- 5
print(number)
print(class(number))
#and finally onto a logical variable
wednesday <- TRUE
print(wednesday)
print(class(wednesday))
```
attributes of two batches of cells
```{r}
#attributes of treated batch
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
treated_1 <- TRUE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432 


#attributes of non-treated batch
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543
```

attributes of two batches of cells as vectors
```{r}
#vector for ID
cell_ID <- c("CX1", "CX2")
print(cell_ID)
#vector for treatment
treated <- c(TRUE, FALSE)
print(treated)
#vector for number of cells before
num_cells_before <- c(5415, 8123)
print(num_cells_before)
#vector for number of cells after
num_cells_after <- c(1432, 7543)
print(num_cells_after)
```
another vector exercise
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
would_eat <- all_my_pets[4]
print(would_eat)
```

data frame for attributions of cell batches
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_ID,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = num_cells_before,
  num_cells_after = num_cells_after
)
gt(my_data_frame)
```
